theme: Clean, calm and minimal with organic warmth (Art of Living)
context: Multi-tenant Art of Living city sites (e.g., Ottawa, Montreal, Toronto). Server-rendered public pages with React SPA dashboard/admin.

colors.wcag_compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA - Minimum contrast 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large UI components/headers.

header_layout_spec.background: #FFFFFF with 1px bottom border (#E7E5E4) and subtle shadow
header_layout_spec.logo_area: Top-left. Golden Sun SVG with two swans icon + text 'THE ART OF LIVING' (or city-overridden custom logo). Height: 40px.
header_layout_spec.top_right_actions: Flex container with EN/FR language switcher toggle (active item: bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 font-semibold) + 'Sign up / Log in' Clerk button
header_layout_spec.desktop_nav: Sticky header with z-index 40, non-transparent background to prevent text bleed during scroll

home_page_spec.type: Server-rendered HTML with minimal inline CSS
home_page_spec.layout: Clean full-width container with centered main section, generous whitespace (py-16, px-6)
home_page_spec.hello_text_styling: font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 600; color: #1C1917; text-transform: lowercase; letter-spacing: -0.02em; padding: 4rem 1.5rem; text-align: left;
home_page_spec.content: Only displays 'hello {city}' (e.g. hello ottawa) inside clean container

unknown_host_404_spec.title: This site is not configured
unknown_host_404_spec.layout: Centered card on #FAF9F6 background with golden/warm minimal icon
unknown_host_404_spec.description: The requested domain or city site is not configured in the system.

admin_layout_spec.structure: Responsive sidebar or top tabs navigation (Access Logs, Site Configuration, Text & Languages, Users & Admins)
admin_layout_spec.sidebar_style: Background #FFFFFF, border-r #E7E5E4, active tab bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border-l-4 border-amber-600
admin_layout_spec.dashboard_heading: Signed in dashboard header shows 'Coming up' section with upcoming city events card grid

table_and_form_styles.tables: Dense, clean design. Header: bg-stone-100 text-stone-700 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider. Rows: hover bg-stone-50 transition-colors border-b border-stone-200.
table_and_form_styles.access_logs_table: Columns: Time, IP, Host, Path, City. Filters by city/host dropdown + search input + pagination controls.
table_and_form_styles.side_by_side_editor: Text & Languages module: EN and FR side-by-side textareas/inputs with real-time dirty status indicator and save button.
table_and_form_styles.site_config_forms: Form fields for cityId, displayName, timezone, hosts list, nearby cities, contact email/phone, default locale, and logo upload preview.
table_and_form_styles.user_management: User table with role badge (User/Admin), Promote to Admin / Demote button with confirmation dialog.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transition: all in CSS/Tailwind classes. Use targeted transition-colors or transition-opacity.
Ensure all interactive components have explicit data-testid attributes for automated verification.
Maintain strict WCAG 2.1 AA contrast levels (text-stone-900 on white or warm sand background).
Never use transparent header backgrounds without background color or backdrop-blur.
All React code files must use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) extensions.
Ensure the server-rendered home page uses plain HTML with minimal inline styles matching #FAF9F6 background and #1C1917 typography.
